name: Blankenheim (Germany)
description: Hanging banner with vertical stripes of black, yellow and black in the proportions 1:4:1, charged at the top with the black eagle of the municipal arms of Blankenheim.
history: By deed of the Regierungspräsident in Aachen of 8 September 1971 the municipality was granted the right to bear arms and a flag; the flag (banner) is black-yellow-black 1:4:1 striped lengthwise with the municipal arms.

features.role: eagle with red bar from the municipal arms
